scripts.build: node scripts/generate-overswing-icons.mjs && vite build && node scripts/finalize-release.mjs dist site
scripts.build:overswing: node scripts/generate-overswing-icons.mjs && vite build --mode overswing --outDir dist-overswing && node scripts/finalize-release.mjs dist-overswing standalone
scripts.package:crazygames: npm run build:overswing && node scripts/verify-release.mjs dist-overswing standalone && cd dist-overswing && zip -qr ../overswing-crazygames.zip .
